en.t: Only when I gaze toward the road ahead, it is vast and uncertain, impossible to know.

units.source_text: 堕尽忧疑之泪，但觉心绪黯然。”

en.t: Having shed all my tears of sorrow and doubt, I feel only that my heart is dark and heavy."

units.source_text: 说罢，便在黎明的微光中退出了。

en.t: When he had finished speaking, he withdrew in the faint light of dawn.
